$Comment: The Full Table: the season's capstone, earned the moment every achievement tagged full_table in the
Seasons > Harvest_Feast subcategory is earned in the same year. MetaSelector picks them, so a new
full_table achievement counts toward it with no edit here; it never picks itself or another
capstone. It inherits the yearly occurrence, so each year has its own copy, and it pays the title
Harvest_Feast_Full_Table through the Title reward kind, on unlock. Keep the full_table tag off this
Every yearly Harvest Feast achievement (one with the base as its Parent) carries full_table, and
each asks for something a player can do alone in one feast: be there (Guest), sit down to The Feast
(Keepsake), take the supper round (Supper_Round), hunt turkeys (Turkey_Chaser), pick crops
(Full_Baskets), do daily jobs (Helping_Hands) and beat the Great Turkey once (Great_Turkey_Down).
Anything longer, a ladder, a rank or a set, is kept for good instead, with no Parent and no tag.
Each year's copy also pays Harvest Coins to spend at Martha's shop, and offers MMO Skill Tree's
Mmo_Boost_Token: half again as much XP in every skill for an hour, which the player starts when it
suits them. Both wait in Rewards.Claim on the achievements page, and the collect notice lists them.
The token row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that
mod, unpaid and unshown, and the coins still pay.
